welcome_returning:
👋 Welcome back to *{businessName}*!

Glad to have you with us again. How can we assist you today?
main_menu_body: Please select what you would like to do:
action_order_now_desc: Browse our popular dishes and place an order
action_track_order_desc: Check live status of your recent order
action_hours_location_desc: Check operating hours and restaurant address
action_agent_desc: Connect directly with our support team
catalog_body: Choose any dish from the list below to order:
select_quantity:
You selected *{itemName}* ({currency}{price}).

Please select the quantity you would like to order:
(You can reply with 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, or type 'cancel')
ask_address:
Great! You have selected *{quantity}x {itemName}* (Total: {currency}{total}).

Please enter your *Delivery Address* (including flat/house no., street, and landmark):
order_success:
🎉 *Order Placed Successfully!*

Order ID: *#{orderNumber}*
Total: *{currency}{total}*
Status: *PLACED*

Our kitchen has received your order and will start preparing it soon. We will notify you here when the status changes!

Type *status* anytime to track this order, or *menu* to return to the main menu.
order_cancelled: ❌ Order has been cancelled. You can type *menu* whenever you'd like to browse again.
no_active_orders:
You do not have any recent orders. Would you like to view our menu and order now?

Type *order* or *menu*.
agent_handoff_started:
🤝 An agent has been notified! Our team will message you shortly.

The automated assistant is currently paused for this chat. Our staff will assist you directly.
agent_handoff_resumed: 🤖 You are now back in automated assistant mode. Type *menu* or *hi* to see available options.
lang_changed: ✅ Language changed to English! Type *menu* to explore options.
opt_out_success:
🛑 You have successfully unsubscribed. You will not receive any further automated messages or promotional broadcasts from us.

To subscribe again, simply reply with *START*.
opt_in_success:
✅ Welcome back! You have re-subscribed to updates from *{businessName}*.

Type *menu* to view our options.
fallback_message:
🤔 I didn't quite catch that. You can type:
• *menu* - to see all options
• *order* - to place an order
• *status* - to check your order
• *agent* - to speak to a person
• *stop* - to unsubscribe
status_update_notification:
🔔 *Status Update for Order #{orderNumber}*

Your order is now: *{status}*

Thank you for choosing {businessName}!
